cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

ctvs/math/Quote.title: Quote
ctvs/math/Quote.description: Exact, unbounded intermediate arithmetic. Execution validates bounded results.

ctvs/price/Price.title: Price
ctvs/price/Price.description:
One market and asset pair per invocation. Evidence is provider-specific Data
 with an explicit common resource bound. Providers must authenticate it and
 verify every assertion against one coherent accounting basis. Signatures,
 when needed, live inside that provider's evidence schema.

ctvs/price/PriceAssertion.title: PriceAssertion
ctvs/price/PriceAssertion.description:
Constructor order and input-first field order are candidate wire commitments.
 Conversions exclude action fees; previews include the declared action fees.
 All quantities are ledger base units. Results round down except PreviewMint
 and PreviewWithdraw, whose required input quantities round up.

ctvs/wire/ActionEnvelope.title: ActionEnvelope
ctvs/wire/ActionEnvelope.description:
The outer constructor commits to a script purpose/role in addition to the
 inner action. A payload valid in one role cannot be reused as another role.

ctvs/wire/Controller.title: Controller
ctvs/wire/Controller.description:
Cancellation authority only. It need not identify the refund destination or
 the successful settlement receiver. ExpiryRefund does not require its signature.

ctvs/wire/DeliverEntry.title: DeliverEntry
ctvs/wire/DeliverEntry.description:
Every consumed Claim gets a separate output index, even for identical receivers.
 Entries collectively cover all Claims consumed at this delivery script.

ctvs/wire/Destination.title: Destination
ctvs/wire/Destination.description:
Fix the whole supported address and datum form, not just a payment key.
 None requires no output datum; Some requires an equal inline datum.

ctvs/wire/Recovery.title: Recovery
ctvs/wire/Recovery.description:
The stable refund envelope stays usable even when economic_body is unsupported.
 Cancellation requires the controller; permissionless expiry uses the lower time
 bound so the entire transaction validity interval is at or after the deadline.

ctvs/wire/RequestBody.title: RequestBody
ctvs/wire/RequestBody.description:
Settlement intent interpreted only by the supported asynchronous family.
 Offered/minimum quantities change units with kind: assets/shares for deposits,
 shares/assets for redemptions. All ADA budgets below are separate from pricing.

ctvs/wire/SettleEntry.title: SettleEntry
ctvs/wire/SettleEntry.description:
Associate one actual Request input with its distinct funded Claim output.
 claim_topup is external ADA added by this transaction, not extra offered assets.

ctvs/wire/Settlers.title: Settlers
ctvs/wire/Settlers.description:
AnySettler removes key-list restrictions, not the explicit settler signature.
 KeySet entries must be sorted, unique 28-byte keys within the profile limit.
